claims.object_text: hub target identified by LASSO, RF, and SVM
claims.quote: ultimately identified six hub targets using three proven machine learning methods (LASSO, RF, and SVM): CREBBP, BCL6, CXCR4, GRIN1, GOT2, and ITGA5.

claims.object_text: good binding ability between MEP and GRIN1 (molecular docking)
claims.quote: Molecular docking analysis showed a good binding ability between MEP and CREBBP, BCL6, CXCR4, GRIN1, GOT2 and ITGA5.
Overall, CREBBP, BCL6, CXCR4, GRIN1, GOT2, and ITGA5 have been identified as the crucial targets correlating with AD.
